KNOW #10 📚 Major, Minor, Exotic
Saare currency pairs ek jaise nahi hote.
• Majors me USD hota hai, jaise EURUSD, GBPUSD. Spread sabse kam.
• Minors me USD nahi, jaise EURGBP, GBPJPY. Thoda zyada spread.
• Exotics jaise USDTRY, USDZAR. Spread bahut zyada, achanak jumps.
Tip: shuruaat majors se karo.
Aur seekhna hai to follow karo. Trade setups ke liye Telegram join karo — link bio me 🕷️
